description: The individual tokenized US rental properties behind the RealT entry, each with net rental yield (annual net rent / tokenized property value), token price, monthly rent and occupancy. Filters by city, yield and token price.

city.description: City name, e.g. Detroit, Cleveland, Chicago

max_token_price_usd.description: Maximum price per token in USD

min_yield_pct.description: Minimum net rental yield in percent

offset.description: Number of matches to skip; the nextOffset of a previous answer continues from there (absent at the end).

rented_only.description: Only properties with at least one rented unit (default true)

sort.description: Sort by net yield (default), token price (cheapest first) or monthly rent

name: search_realt_properties

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; absent when there is no more

title: Search RealT properties
